status: Public source prerelease and website live; v0.1.21-alpha.2 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB, Wi-Fi, an always-on relay, phone-only setup, two-account claim, signed updates over the relay a builder's dry run on a fresh relay and per-account credits on the owner's relay; native Grok Bot calls observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: The v0.1.21-alpha.2 candidate adds the credits per gadget-day record (docs/verification/credits-pricing-2026-10-23.md). Gadget-days were charged live for a non-operator owner on 4 of 4 days, at 1 credit per gadget-day with the default weights. Receipts verified and the report reconciled. The kit got no commands during the run, so command use is not tested; the owner ended the run on 23 October. ADR 016 stays Proposed. Nothing is sold and there are no payments. Component pins are unchanged: gateway v0.1.0-alpha.20, ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.19, Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.10 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. A builder outside the project (#269) and a tester's report (#185) remain open.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; relay with accounts and signed updates used by one physical kit; a builder's relay set up from relay init on a fresh host; native Grok Bot calls through serve --oauth observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: 595 tests (Python 3.11 to 3.14), Ruff, the first-success path and the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed. Alpha.20 adds credits per account (serve --credits with --accounts): a ledger in oauth/, a debit before each command with refunds when it does not go out, out_of_credits with plain text and no price or link, the caller's own balance in the list, gadget-days, daily Ed25519-signed hash-chained receipts and the credits commands (grant, allowance, settings, close, list, ledger, receipts, verify, report). Off by default. On 20 October 2026 the owner's relay ran this code for the credits acceptance (hub docs/verification/credits-2026-10-20.md). Alpha.19 made the sign-in page calmer; alpha.18 added long-poll, sign-in by Client ID Metadata Document, oauth watch, fleet and serve --max-devices.

Tests passed, including the real gateway relay listener, long-poll against the real gateway and the protocol pin comparison against gateway 0.1.0-alpha.18 (70fbd43); Ruff, package builds and the release workflow's SHA256SUMS check passed; PyPI 0.1.0a10 matches SHA256SUMS. Adds --wait-ms / Agent(wait_ms=) for long-poll. Long-poll from a Linux agent on hardware is not tested.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; nine firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB, Wi-Fi, signed updates over the relay and a builder's dry run on a fresh relay; climate sensor, switch and servo not tested on hardware
components.checks: Host tests (16 suites, including long-poll), the contract check against the protocol pinned at gateway 0.1.0-alpha.18 (70fbd43) and all nine CI firmware builds passed. Adds Gadget::longPoll(), on in the OLED kit and grok::WifiApp. On 18 October 2026 the owner's kit took v0.2.0-alpha.19 by signed update and long-polled through the relay (17 requests in 30 s). The climate sensor, switch and servo examples are not tested on hardware. Earlier: Host CTest suites (15/15, including the app tests), the contract check with the new transcripts and the firmware builds passed. Alpha.18 adds grok::WifiApp and the climate sensor, switch and servo examples (host models only) and the Ship a gadget guide. On 17 October 2026 the owner's kit passed batch provisioning, phone setup, claim, Grok Bot text and a signed update on a fresh relay (hub docs/verification/builder-kit-2026-10-17.md).

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.
